rows.en: I'm counting on your performance.
Mission start. Be careful.
Get a job this size done for me.
Mission start. Don't let your guard down.
It's started. Don't let your guard down.
Please come back safe.
Come back safe. No matter what.
Hey, you'll be fine as long as you listen to me.
Victory is with you.
Watch your surroundings during the operation.
You'll be fine! I'm sure you'll succeed!
Don't get hurt being reckless. You're a woman.
Don't fail. Well, I don't need to tell you that.
Live up to my expectations.
I'm counting on you. Don't let me down.
I'll back you up properly too.
I'm expecting a lot from you. Don't let me down.
Sorry I always end up relying on you.
Show me your true ability.
Listen to my intel during the operation.
I'll be praying for your safety.
Rely on my support.
With my precise orders and your skill, it's a breeze, right?
You're not alone. We're here too.
Operation start. Tighten up and go.
I'm watching your brilliant flying.
Come back and show me you're safe. Promise.
I just can't picture you failing.
Do it your way. I believe in you.
I think you'll be fine, but be careful.
Please count on my support.
Show me that spirited flying of yours.
I guess this feeling is relief.
Be careful. Me, worrying about someone else.
Come back, without fail. Promise.
All right, let's wrap this up quickly!
Finish fast so we make it to the party.
I'll be waiting for you to come back.
Come back. I'm waiting.
Don't take reckless risks and worry me so much.
Oh, is it over? Good work.
There, well done.
Don't worry about it. I never expected anything from the start.
Heh, you actually made it back alive.
You were lucky to finish safely.
That's only because it was this mission, right?
rows.notes: Sentence is cut off; read as a gentle jab that the mission was easy.

rows.en: Coming back safe... a miracle?
You were lucky just to survive.
Looks like you didn't fail. But that's all.
Never mind, just return to base quickly. Honestly.
Um, will you be okay next time?
Well, for a mission this easy, naturally.
I thought your skills were a bit better. I guess I overestimated you.
A mission this easy, naturally.
Mission over. Return quickly.
The mission is over. Please return immediately.
Mission over. Come home carefully.
Mission accomplished. Well, that's about what I expected.
Mission over. Return immediately.
Mission over. Return to base.
Looks like nothing happened. Thank goodness.
Looks like it ended safely. Good work.
You did well, for you.
Looks like it's done. Good work.
Hmph, it's over. You come back too.
Good work. Go home and relax.
Now, rest well for the next one.
You followed my orders well. I'll give you credit for that.
No particular problems with this mission.
Mission over. Good work.
Keep it up from here on, too.
How was my support? Not that I'll accept complaints.
I said you could do it. Of course you succeeded.
Not bad. I'm counting on you next time too.
Glad it ended safely. Thank you.
My support was helpful, wasn't it?
Your skill was as expected. Keep it up.
I'm counting on you from now on, too. Got it? From now on, too.
I've seen your skill.
Quite a skillful performance.
